description: Lists aicut's trend-template niches: one-shot video formats made from a few answers (and sometimes a picture), each at one price. AI Video Story series are `list_series`, not these. WITHOUT `slug`: the cards (`slug`, `name`, `description`, `suits`, `not_for`, `price`, `agent_supported`). Shortlist 3-5 that fit, saying what each makes and what it is NOT for; never dump the list. WITH `slug`: that ONE niche in full, REQUIRED before `generate_from_niche`: its `inputs` (answers by `key`; a media input lists its `presets` and `sources`), `settings` (defaults and options) and `revision`. `price.tokens` is the quote at the DEFAULT settings only: price the real request with `generate_from_niche` and `estimate_only`. The flow: `get_recipe` `niche-run`.

slug.description: A niche's `slug` from the list: returns that ONE niche in full. Omit for the cards.

name: list_niches
title: List the one-shot video niches
